technologies.subtitle: Skills
technologies.title: Technologies I work with
technologies.description: I am always eager to learn new technologies and improve my skills.

skills.TypeScript: I regularly use TypeScript in both my job and academic work. It's also the language I chose for personal projects, including building this portfolio.
skills.Vue: While working at GEPROG, I gained hands-on experience with Vue.js across several projects, building responsive user interfaces and deepening my understanding of this framework. I also used Vue.js during my Erasmus semester to build AI Genie, a host for the AI Lab at OsloMet University.
skills.Nuxt 3: I worked with Nuxt 3 at GEPROG and also used it to build this portfolio.
skills.React: At OTTO, I am working on multiple projects with React, building components and user interfaces for web applications. This helped me improve my knowledge of React's ecosystem and best practices.
skills.Tailwind CSS: I used Tailwind CSS at both OpenCampus, GEPROG as well as my personal projects to create clean, responsive designs.
skills.Flutter: As part of my studies, I used Flutter to build a mobile app that connected people with job opportunities nearby. This project helped me develop skills in mobile app development with a focus on cross-platform solutions.
skills.C++: In my studies, I worked with C++ on a project where my team created a human benchmark game. This project allowed me to enhance my programming skills through practical applications and teamwork.
skills.Go: I used Go for my bachelor thesis at OTTO and continued working with it in my day-to-day projects there. This gave me practical experience with Go in a professional environment.
skills.Figma: I've used Figma in both academic and work settings for designing user interfaces. It's been especially useful for planning the layout of this portfolio and other projects.

about.subtitle: About me
about.title: My journey into technology
text: My path into tech started in an unexpected way. Studying Sociology and Educational Science taught me how technology can influence people and communities.
Now, while pursuing my Master’s in Computer Science at the University of Applied Sciences Kiel, I’m learning to combine technical skills with an awareness of human needs.

data.name: knittly
data.subTitle: Personal Project with Vue and TypeScript
data.description: A minimalist mobile-first application designed to help knitters track and manage their knitting projects. Features stitch counting, row tracking, and project organization with a clean, mobile-optimized interface built with Vue and TypeScript.

data.name: Grade Trace
data.subTitle: Personal Project with Nuxt
data.description: This is a personal project that I started to keep track of my university grades. It is built with Nuxt3 and is hosted on Vercel.

data.name: tictacthetoe
data.subTitle: Personal Project with Nuxt
data.description: This is the second rendition of my university project ultimateTicTacToe. I wanted to do it with Nuxt3. The game is hosted on vercel.

data.name: AIGenie
data.subTitle: University Project with Vue, Python, and TypeScript
data.description: A mobile web application that serves as a host for the AI Lab of OsloMet University. Features an interactive AI assistant chat interface, information about researchers, research project details, and upcoming events exploration. Developed in a team of four with cross-functional collaboration. I was responsible for the frontend development using Vue and TypeScript

data.name: ultimateTicTacToe
data.subTitle: University Project with vanilla JS, HTML, and CSS
data.description: A second-semester project in the 'Web Applications' module. This implementation of tic-tac-toe introduces an additional layer of complexity, where each square contains a smaller tic-tac-toe board. The mark on a small board determines the the next larger board, adding a strategic element to the game. The win of a small board determines the mark on the larger board.

data.name: WA-FeWo
data.subTitle: University Project with vanilla JS, HTML, and CSS
data.description: A second-semester project in the 'Web Applications' module, focusing on the development of a booking platform for holiday flats. The application processes data from an Airbnb CSV file to display available rentals.
